scope: evidence versus hypotheses in race review
voluntary training or tuning goal linked to next-race conditions and measurements
three fixed challenges with frozen entrants, CPU, gear, weather and courses
separate manual and auto records, settings groups, cosmetic honors and saved bests
old-save, stale-action, ordinary cup and career isolation
limitations: Production DOM/input handlers run in adapters, not real layout or touchscreen.
No browser screenshots or physical-device/audio/FPS verification.
Reports named V144 and earlier are historical.
Fixed challenges are local records, not an online verified leaderboard.
Short careers stop after two qualifiers and, when qualified, one final; they do not advance the ten-part heroine routes.
